pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 菠菜 (bōcài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Apple
   B. Mango
   C. Dinner
   D. Spinach

2. Which word is pronounced xīngqītiān? (1 mark)
   A. 七
   B. 学校
   C. 星期天
   D. 去

3. Read the pinyin: zhè shì wǒ māma. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. That is my older brother.
   C. This is my mother.
   D. There are five people in my family.

4. Read the pinyin: wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink tea.
   B. For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   C. This is a banana.
   D. I like to drink tea.

5. What is back-chaining? (1 mark)
   A. Writing backwards
   B. Building a long sentence from its end
   C. Reading only the first word
   D. Singing a song

6. What does 天气 (tiānqì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Weather
   B. Also
   C. Big
   D. The wind blows

7. What does 里 (lǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To put
   B. Bathroom
   C. Inside
   D. Door

8. What does 云 (yún) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. It rains
   C. Not
   D. Cloud

9. What does 错 cuò mean in a true-or-false exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Wrong
   B. Rain
   C. Today
   D. Right

10. Which sentence means "I have two eyes."? (1 mark)
   A. 我有两只眼睛。
   B. 我用嘴巴说。
   C. 我用耳朵听。
   D. 我用眼睛看。

11. Why should you not shout when reading aloud? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting makes tones clearer
   B. Shouting is polite
   C. Shouting is quiet
   D. Shouting spoils the tones and hurts the throat

12. Which word is pronounced nín hǎo? (1 mark)
   A. 谢谢
   B. 呢
   C. 你
   D. 您好

13. What should a group do first when planning a showcase? (1 mark)
   A. Throw away materials
   B. Skip practice
   C. Choose an item and make a plan
   D. Perform at once

14. Which word means "under" in 椅子在桌子下? (1 mark)
   A. 上
   B. 下
   C. 桌
   D. 在

15. What does 请再说一遍 qǐng zài shuō yí biàn mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you very much
   B. Please say it once more
   C. Please sit down
   D. Good morning

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my younger brother." (2 marks)

17. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Saturday I rest at home." (3 marks)

18. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." (2 marks)

19. Give the Mandarin words for older brother, younger brother and younger sister, with pinyin. (3 marks)

20. Give three tips for neat Chinese handwriting. (3 marks)

21. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 椅子 and 谁. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Spinach
   菠菜 (bōcài) means spinach.

2. C — 星期天
   星期天 is pronounced xīngqītiān and means Sunday.

3. C — This is my mother.
   zhè shì wǒ māma. is 这是我妈妈。, which means "This is my mother.".

4. B — For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng. is 我早饭吃饼。, which means "For breakfast I eat bǐng.".

5. B — Building a long sentence from its end
   You start with the last part and add one part at a time.

6. A — Weather
   天气 (tiānqì) means weather.

7. C — Inside
   里 (lǐ) means inside.

8. D — Cloud
   云 (yún) means cloud.

9. A — Wrong
   错 is wrong; 对 is right.

10. A — 我有两只眼睛。
   我有两只眼睛。 (wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.) means "I have two eyes.".

11. D — Shouting spoils the tones and hurts the throat
   Use projection, not shouting.

12. D — 您好
   您好 is pronounced nín hǎo and means hello (polite).

13. C — Choose an item and make a plan
   A plan says who does what.

14. B — 下
   下 xià means under or below.

15. B — Please say it once more
   It is a polite way to ask for a repeat.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 那是我弟弟。 nà shì wǒ dìdi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期六在家休息。 wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: 哥哥 gēge, 弟弟 dìdi, 妹妹 mèimei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with pinyin.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Keep characters the same size, keep strokes firm and straight, leave equal spaces, write in the right stroke order, do not join separate strokes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 椅子: yǐzi, chair. 谁: shéi, who.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
